sutta: militia chapter on the patali village 8.1 patama parinivana that's how I heard at one time the Lord was staying near savati in the Jeter wood and anata of indica's Monastery on that occasion the Lord was instructing rousing inspiring and gladdening the monks with the Dharma talk connected with Nirvana and those monks being receptive and attentive and concerned and concentrating the whole mind of intent on listening to dhamma then on realizing its significance the Lord uttered on that occasion this inspired utterance the rich monks That Base where there is no Earth no water no fire no air no base consisting of the Infinity of space no base consisting of the Infinity of Consciousness no base consisting of nothingness no base consisting of perception or non-perception neither this world nor another world nor both neither Sun nor Moon here monks I see there is no coming no going no staying no deceasing no Uprising not fixed not movable it has no support just this is the end of suffering so here the Buddha is talking about the state now of cessation cessation of perception and feeling which is also the cessation of Consciousness when the normal six Consciousness stops there there is no the four elements that the four elements earth water fire air or wind signifies the physical world so the physical world has disappeared and also there's no sun in Moon then and although there is no sun in Moonah yet it is Bright Now but there's no objects there also and when there's no objects there's no self or so so when a person enters this state of Association of perception and feeling when he comes out of it now he automatically becomes an arahan
